http_request_transform.description: Infovore Labs: serve the R2 index object for the site root

http_request_cache_settings.description: Infovore Labs: re-fetch entry pages and mutable documents
Infovore Labs: cache content-addressed public assets
http_request_cache_settings.expression: (http.host in {"infovore-labs.com" "www.infovore-labs.com"} and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/notes-assets/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/projects-assets/")))

http_response_headers_transform.description: Infovore Labs: prevent staging indexing; preserve object cache policy
